description: This file defines the AttributeValue class, which models attribute values for products, including properties like name, description, image, price, and whether it is a default attribute. It extends ShopEntity and implements Serializable.

classes.name: AttributeValue
classes.description: Class representing a product attribute value with properties like name, description, image, price, and default status.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the attribute value.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the attribute value.

methods.name: isDefaultAttribute
methods.description: Checks if this attribute value is the default.

methods.name: setDefaultAttribute
methods.description: Sets whether this attribute value is the default.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Gets the image associated with the attribute value.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image associated with the attribute value.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Returns the price associated with the attribute value.

methods.name: setPrice
methods.description: Sets the price for the attribute value.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the attribute value.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the attribute value.
